Portfolio.title: Eight projects. One evolving visual practice.
Portfolio.subtitle: Selected animation, promotional video, social content, event, editing, and narrative work from Esteban's portfolio.

animation.title: Animation
animation.description: 3D motion, key visuals, and product imagery developed for brand storytelling.

business-promos.title: Business Promos
business-promos.description: Selected promotional videos created for brands and local businesses.

social-content.title: Social Content
social-content.description: Video and visual work created for social-media publishing.

events.title: Events
events.description: Wedding-film and event-focused work from the selected portfolio.

editing.title: Editing
editing.description: Scripted pieces and video edits shaped into a finished story.

narrative.title: Narrative
narrative.description: Short-film and narrative work centered on direction and cinematography.

my-dler.title: My D'ler
my-dler.summary: A brand and pitch package for My D'ler, a food-delivery app, produced through an agency for a client in Ecuador. Esteban created the key visual and social graphics, a 3D video, and product mockups, plus 2D animated videos for the client presentation.
my-dler.credits: Key visual, social graphic design, 2D animation, 3D video, and product mockups for the agency pitch.

banacol.title: Banacol
banacol.summary: A corporate video for Banacol, produced with the Jungelbox agency. Esteban shot the aerial footage across three days at banana and plantain export operations in Urabá, Antioquia, Colombia — including drone flights launched from boats at sea.
banacol.credits: Aerial drone cinematography, on assignment with the Jungelbox agency (Medellín, Colombia).

bar-door-monkey.title: Bar Door Monkey Miami
bar-door-monkey.summary: A social-media promo spot for Bar Door Monkey, a Miami restaurant, produced on location during filming of the Soccer y Más show and delivered for the venue's Instagram.
bar-door-monkey.credits: On-location videography and editing for the venue's social ad spot.

healthy-smile.title: Healthy Smile Miami
healthy-smile.summary: Social-media videos for a Miami dental clinic, produced on assignment with the agency 300 Bees. Esteban filmed on location — video and sound — then edited and delivered the finished pieces for publishing.

homeowners.title: Homeowners
homeowners.summary: A social-media video for Homeowners, edited by Esteban from footage supplied by the agency 300 Bees.
homeowners.credits: Video editing (footage provided by the agency 300 Bees).

diana-jack.title: Diana & Jack
diana-jack.summary: A wedding film shot in Boston, Massachusetts. Esteban was the videographer and editor, delivering a full 20-minute film of the day plus a highlight trailer of about a minute and a half.
diana-jack.credits: Videography and editing; deliverables: a 20-minute film and a highlight trailer.

la-huelga.title: La Huelga
la-huelga.summary: A short film Esteban directed as a university project in Colombia — an original concept, developed with a screenwriter, based on the true story of the Banana Massacre (Masacre de las Bananeras). The production ran about seven months.
la-huelga.credits: Director, director of photography, and original concept (developed with a screenwriter).

ml-colombia.title: ML Colombia
ml-colombia.summary: Content and digital strategy for Miracle Leaf (ML Colombia), Esteban's own CBD-cosmetics e-commerce brand, which he founded and ran for about six years. As CEO he led the brand end to end — digital content, strategy, and two successive websites.
ml-colombia.credits: Founder and CEO; digital content and strategy (own brand).
